text: Ravelin, Oct. 18 — The Brisco County audit found that road maintenance funds totaling 4.7 million thales were missing from the county infrastructure account, according to people familiar with the matter. The review, completed Friday by the firm Halden & Voss, said transfers were approved between March and July but never reached the paving and bridge repair projects listed in the budget. County treasurer Mica Drennan was placed on administrative leave pending a separate probe, the people said. Supervisors are expected to vote Monday on emergency repairs for the north loop and three rural culverts after warning that delayed resurfacing has already pushed costs higher.
